entry.summary:
RT Mario Nawfal SOLAR PANELS THAT OUTLIVE YOUR MORTGAGE: WHY TODAY'S TECH LASTS 40+ YEARS Solar panels don’t just “pay for themselves” - they stick around. Glass-on-glass designs, lower annual efficiency loss (~0.4%), and no moving parts mean today’s panels can easily last 40–50 years with minimal upkeep. Longer lifespan = lower energy costs, fewer replacements, and more time before we deal with panel waste. The twist? You might swap phones 20 times before your roof even thinks about quitting.
